corrections_to_previous_batch.macro_head_evaluation: Acknowledged that constant training mean MAE (0.07039) and RMSE (0.09327) were superior to Ridge MAE (0.07241) and RMSE (0.09567). Retracted premature claim of 'strong/significant predictive power'.
corrections_to_previous_batch.causal_inference_retraction: Retracted speculation about tree threshold suppression causing stock hit drop (52 -> 47); retained purely as empirical non-improvement.

old_17_vs_new_5_distinction.old_17_truth: Had dated intervals, homophone families, diffusion counts, and intra-group ladder structure, but evaluated closing winners on day S in ST_DUAL with strict group size thresholds.
old_17_vs_new_5_distinction.new_5_innovation: Evaluates fixed S-1 cohort across day S into first-board pool, explicitly tracks non-limit failures and <= -7% losses, and removes size thresholds.

proposed_5_features.name: prior_name_anchor_present
proposed_5_features.definition: Indicator of whether an anchor with height >= 3 existed on S-1 in candidate's name/token family

proposed_5_features.name: name_anchor_current_mean_return
proposed_5_features.definition: Day S mean return of the S-1 anchor cohort. Strictly NaN if no anchor existed.

proposed_5_features.name: name_anchor_current_limit_survival
proposed_5_features.definition: Day S limit-up survival fraction of the S-1 anchor cohort. Strictly NaN if no anchor existed.

proposed_5_features.name: name_prev_followers_current_mean_return
proposed_5_features.definition: Day S mean return of the S-1 lower-tier (1-2 board) followers, excluding candidate itself. Strictly NaN if follower cohort is empty.

proposed_5_features.name: name_prev_followers_current_loss7_share
proposed_5_features.definition: Day S fraction of S-1 lower-tier followers closing <= -7.0%. Strictly NaN if follower cohort is empty.

edge_case_disciplines.multi_group_handling: Union deduplication across matching token/phonetic families; zero post-hoc cherry-picking.
edge_case_disciplines.missing_data_discipline: Requires known == total & total > 0; incomplete cohorts yield NaN without deleting candidate rows.
